description: Hypothesis-driven experimentation workflow for LPWAN (LoRaWAN / NB-IoT) testing-as-a-service: from hypothesis definition and testbed reservation to deployment, execution, monitoring, analysis, and rollback.

project_id.description: Identifier for a user's LPWAN experimentation project

hypothesis_id.description: Identifier for a hypothesis within a project

experiment_id.description: Identifier for a specific experiment instance

reservation_id.description: Identifier for a reserved LPWAN testbed timeslot

testbed_id.description: Identifier for a physical or virtual LPWAN testbed

device_profile_id.description: Identifier for a reusable LPWAN device profile (radio + application parameters)

firmware_bundle_id.description: Identifier for a firmware bundle or application image used in experiments

run_id.description: Identifier for a single execution run of an experiment

analysis_job_id.description: Identifier for an analysis job over experiment data

rollback_plan_id.description: Identifier for a rollback plan to restore device/testbed state after failed experiments

audit_event_id.description: Identifier of an audit log entry.

subscription_id.description: Identifier of a webhook or notification subscription.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of a captured state snapshot.

functions.name: create_experiment_project
functions.description: Create a new LPWAN experimentation project and initial hypothesis definition.

description.description: High-level description of the experimentation goals

lpwan_technologies.description: LPWAN technologies targeted in this project

owner_user_id.description: User ID of the project owner

members.description: List of team members and their roles

initial_hypothesis.description: Optional initial hypothesis to attach to the project

statement.description: Formal hypothesis statement, e.g., 'ADR reduces energy by 20% under mobility'

metrics.description: Primary metrics that will be used to validate the hypothesis

tags.description: Arbitrary key-value tags for organizing hypotheses

functions.returns: Project identifier, optional initial hypothesis_id, and project metadata.

functions.name: define_hypothesis
functions.description: Create or update a hypothesis within an LPWAN experimentation project.

hypothesis_id.description: Provide to update an existing hypothesis; omit to create a new one

experimental_factors.description: Configurable factors that will be varied in the experiment design

levels.description: Allowed values or ranges for this factor

lpwan_scope.description: Where this factor applies in the LPWAN stack

response_variables.description: Measured variables used to accept or reject the hypothesis

success_criteria.description: Criteria for considering the hypothesis validated or invalidated

minimum_effect_size.description: Minimum detectable effect size for key metrics

replications.description: Minimum number of experiment runs required

functions.returns: Hypothesis identifier and full hypothesis definition.

functions.name: plan_lpwan_experiment
functions.description: Design an LPWAN experiment for a given hypothesis, including testbeds, device profiles, and trial matrix.

device_profiles.description: Device profiles to use in this experiment

device_profile_id.description: Existing profile ID; omit to inline a one-off profile

inline_profile.description: Definition of a one-off device profile if no ID is provided

replicas.description: Number of devices of this profile to include

trial_design.description: Design of trials and randomized runs

trials.description: Explicit trial definitions when using custom_matrix or overrides

factor_settings.description: Mapping from factor name to chosen level for this trial

blocking_factor.description: Optional blocking factor such as time-of-day

firmware_bundle_id.description: Firmware bundle to flash onto devices for this experiment

functions.returns: Planned experiment_id with resolved testbed candidates, device allocations, and trial matrix summary.

functions.name: check_testbed_availability
functions.description: Check availability and constraints of LPWAN testbeds for a planned experiment.

time_window.description: Desired time window for running the experiment

testbed_filters.description: Optional filters to narrow down testbeds

allow_fragmentation.description: Allow booking multiple disjoint slots to fulfill duration

functions.returns: List of candidate testbeds with available slots, constraints, and estimated cost per slot.

functions.name: reserve_testbed_slot
functions.description: Reserve one or more LPWAN testbed slots for a specific experiment.

slots.description: One or more time slots to reserve on the chosen testbed

priority.description: Priority for scheduling if contention exists

functions.returns: Reservation_id, reservation status, and details of confirmed or waitlisted slots.

functions.name: configure_devices_and_firmware
functions.description: Configure device profiles, firmware images, and logical groupings for a reserved experiment.

device_groups.description: Logical groups of devices with specific profiles and firmware

allocation.description: Allocation strategy for devices within the reservation

device_ids.description: Explicit device IDs from the testbed inventory

count.description: Number of devices to allocate dynamically

cron.description: Cron expression in UTC for downlink messages

network_server_overrides.description: Optional per-experiment LPWAN network server configuration

safety_policies.description: Policies to protect hardware and spectrum during the experiment

functions.returns: Confirmation of device and firmware configuration, including resolved device lists and any conflicts.

functions.name: start_experiment_run
functions.description: Start an execution run of a planned LPWAN experiment within a testbed reservation.

run_label.description: Human-readable label for this run, e.g., 'pilot-1'

trial_subset.description: Optional subset of trials to execute in this run

external_endpoints.description: Endpoints for streaming raw and aggregated data

dry_run.description: If true, validate configuration and scheduling without sending real traffic

functions.returns: Run_id, initial run status, and summary of scheduled trials and devices.

functions.name: get_experiment_run_status
functions.description: Retrieve detailed status, progress, and health of an ongoing or completed experiment run.

include.description: Additional sections to include in the status response

time_range.description: Optional time range for metrics and logs

functions.returns: Run status (queued, running, completed, failed, aborted), progress per trial, device and gateway health indicators, and optionally logs/metrics.

functions.name: adjust_or_abort_run
functions.description: Dynamically adjust experiment parameters or abort an ongoing LPWAN experiment run.

parameter_adjustments.description: Only relevant when action is adjust_parameters

global.description: Global adjustments applied to all trials/devices

tx_power_dbm_delta.description: Delta to apply to current TX power (can be negative)

preserve_partial_data.description: If aborting, whether to keep partial data and logs

functions.returns: Updated run status, acknowledgement of adjustments, and any warnings about conflicting changes.

functions.name: retry_experiment_run
functions.description: Create a new run by retrying a failed or partially completed LPWAN experiment run with optional modifications.

failed_run_id.description: Identifier of the previous run to retry

custom_trial_labels.description: Trial labels to re-run when retry_mode is custom_subset

override_reservation_id.description: Optional new reservation to use for the retry

parameter_overrides.description: Adjustments to avoid repeating failure conditions

label_suffix.description: Suffix to append to the new run label to indicate retry

functions.returns: New run_id, mapping from old to new trials, and summary of what will be retried.

functions.name: launch_analysis_job
functions.description: Launch an analysis job to evaluate hypothesis outcomes using data from one or more experiment runs.

run_ids.description: Experiment runs to include in the analysis

analysis_plan.description: Configuration of statistical tests and visualizations

factor_effects.description: List of factors to estimate effects for

data_filters.description: Filters to clean or restrict the dataset before analysis

functions.returns: Analysis_job_id, job status, and links to interim result artifacts.

functions.name: get_analysis_results
functions.description: Retrieve results, artifacts, and hypothesis verdict from an analysis job.

include.description: Sections of analysis to include in the response

pagination.description: Pagination options for large per-trial metrics

functions.returns: Analysis status, statistical results, aggregated metrics, hypothesis verdict (accepted/rejected/inconclusive), and links to downloadable artifacts and plots.

functions.name: create_rollback_plan
functions.description: Create a rollback plan to restore LPWAN devices and testbed configuration after experiments that cause failures or regressions.

target.description: Target resources to which the rollback plan applies

steps.description: Ordered steps to perform during rollback

conditional_on_metric.description: Optional condition to run this step only if a metric threshold is met

auto_apply_on_failure.description: Automatically trigger this rollback plan on run failure

functions.returns: Rollback_plan_id and a validation report of the rollback steps and targets.

functions.name: execute_rollback_plan
functions.description: Execute a previously created rollback plan to restore device and testbed state after an experiment.

dry_run.description: If true, simulate the rollback steps without making changes

override_target.description: Optionally override the original target of the rollback plan

functions.returns: Execution status, list of steps executed or simulated, and any errors encountered during rollback.

functions.name: search_projects
functions.description: Faceted search across project records with rich filters, full-text query, and faceted aggregations for lpwan_experiment_flow.

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

highlight.description: Return highlighted snippets when matching text

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated result set of project records with facet buckets, total count, and continuation cursor.

functions.name: list_projects_by_status
functions.description: List project records filtered by lifecycle status with stable cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated list of project records matching the requested statuses, optionally with summary metrics.

functions.name: get_project_detail
functions.description: Fetch a single project record with optional expansion of related entities and versioned snapshots.

as_of.description: Read the record as of this point in time

version_id.description: Specific version to retrieve when versioning is enabled

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A project record with the requested expansions and version metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_projects
functions.description: Submit a batch of project records for creation, with idempotency keys and partial-success reporting.

tags.description: Tags applied to the new record

trace_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the batch

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A per-item outcome list with created identifiers, validation errors, and batch-level statistics.

functions.name: bulk_update_projects
functions.description: Apply partial updates to many project records in a single transactional batch.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

patch.description: JSON merge-patch applied to every matched record

dry_run.description: Compute affected count without applying changes

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Affected record count, sampled previews, and any per-record errors.

functions.name: bulk_archive_projects
functions.description: Soft-archive project records matching a selector with optional grace period before purge.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

preserve_audit.description: Keep audit trail even after purge

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Archive operation summary including matched count, scheduled purge date, and any blockers.

functions.name: export_projects
functions.description: Asynchronously export a filtered slice of project records to the configured object store.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

destination.description: Where the export should be delivered

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with status, destination URI, and progress callbacks.

functions.name: subscribe_project_events
functions.description: Register a webhook subscription for project lifecycle events with HMAC signing and replay protection.

filter.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

signing_secret_ref.description: Reference to the HMAC signing secret

tls_verify.description: Whether to validate the server certificate

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscription handle including subscription_id, verification status, and current delivery health.

functions.name: unsubscribe_project_events
functions.description: Disable or delete a previously created project event subscription.

drain_seconds.description: Grace period to flush in-flight events

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Final subscription state and any undelivered event counts at the time of termination.

functions.name: get_project_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological audit log for a project including who changed what and when.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An ordered list of audit entries with diffs, actor metadata, and correlation ids.

functions.name: query_project_changelog
functions.description: Query the cross-record changelog for lpwan_experiment_flow with field-level filters.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

fields_changed.description: Restrict to changes touching these fields

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregated changelog rows or detail entries depending on group_by, plus totals.

functions.name: schedule_project_job
functions.description: Create a recurring or one-off scheduled job that runs a lpwan_experiment_flow operation.

operation.description: Operation name to invoke when the schedule fires

input_template.description: Parameters passed to the operation, with templating

failure_policy.description: What to do when a run fails

max_failures.description: Pause schedule after this many failures

alert_channel.description: Channel id to alert on failure

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A schedule descriptor including schedule_id, next run time, and validation issues.

functions.name: pause_project_schedule
functions.description: Temporarily pause a scheduled lpwan_experiment_flow job without deleting its history.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated schedule status and prior pause history.

functions.name: simulate_project_execution
functions.description: Run a dry-run simulation of a lpwan_experiment_flow execution path without producing side effects.

include_side_effect_plan.description: Return the side effects that would have been emitted

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Simulation transcript with predicted outcome, side-effect plan, and assertions checked.

functions.name: preview_project_change
functions.description: Compute a preview of how a proposed change would affect a project prior to commit.

evaluate_policies.description: Run policy engine against the proposed state

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A preview document with field diffs, policy verdicts, and dependency impact.

functions.name: submit_project_for_approval
functions.description: Submit a project for review with configurable approver routing and SLA targets.

approver_group.description: Group or role authorised at this step

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Approval workflow handle with approval_id, current step, and projected completion time.

functions.name: record_project_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/recuse decision for a pending project approval step.

conditions.description: Conditions attached to a conditional approval

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated approval state, next pending step, and any triggered automations.

functions.name: escalate_project
functions.description: Escalate a stuck or breached project to a higher tier with paging and audit.

target_team.description: Team or rota receiving the escalation

context_refs.description: Related artifact ids attached for context

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Escalation record id, paged responders, and acknowledgement timer.

functions.name: add_project_comment
functions.description: Append a comment, optionally with @mentions and visibility scope, to a project.

mentions.description: User ids mentioned in the body

parent_comment_id.description: Comment id this one replies to

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Newly created comment record including comment_id and resolved mentions.

functions.name: attach_project_evidence
functions.description: Upload an evidence file or link as an attachment to a project with content hash and retention.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Attachment descriptor including attachment_id, content hash, and stored URI.

functions.name: snapshot_project_state
functions.description: Capture a point-in-time snapshot of a project and its dependencies for restore or audit.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, captured size, and storage URI.

functions.name: restore_project_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a project (and optionally dependencies) from a previously captured snapshot.

new_owner_id.description: Owner of the restored record when mode=new_record

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Restore job descriptor with conflicts surfaced and final record id.

functions.name: get_project_metrics_summary
functions.description: Compute summary KPIs for lpwan_experiment_flow over a time window with optional segmentation.

metrics.description: Metric names to compute (e.g. throughput, p95_latency, failure_rate)

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

compare_to_previous_period.description: Include delta vs the previous equal-length window

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A metrics document with per-bucket values, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: create_project_dashboard
functions.description: Define a dashboard layout combining charts and tables for lpwan_experiment_flow.

query.description: Query spec, polymorphic by panel type

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Dashboard descriptor including dashboard_id and resolved share list.

functions.name: define_project_policy
functions.description: Create or version a policy controlling allowed lpwan_experiment_flow behaviour.

rules.description: Ordered rule list, first match wins

when.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

enforcement_mode.description: How strictly the policy is applied

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Policy version descriptor with policy_id, version_id, and validation report.

functions.name: evaluate_project_policies
functions.description: Evaluate the active lpwan_experiment_flow policies against a candidate input and return verdicts.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregate verdict, per-rule outcomes, and any obligations attached to the decision.
